text:
sara_support: AcmeRetail (cust acme-9876) just escalated — persistent 429s + intermittent 401s hitting their Dedicated pool during a capacity surge. They say failover to fallback region caused auth failures and duplicate billing events. AE is on the call.

jamie_ops: Which dedicated region?

sara_support: eu-west1 primary, fallback to na-east is configured. Incident started ~2026-11-02T14:23:10Z per customer timeline. They noticed errors when their traffic spiked (autoscale).

mike_infra: I'm seeing allocator backlog in eu-west1 around that time. GPUs saturated, placement started rejecting requests with NoCompatibleNode, then immediately routed to na-east. Logs show lots of placement-retry loops.

ravi_sre: Can you paste a sample of the 401? Curious if it's token validation failing or service-account mapping missing in fallback pool.

emma_cse: Customer also reported charges appearing twice for some requests — probably retries creating duplicate billable events. They're pretty upset about the billing noise.

billing-bot: Detected duplicate charge pattern for acct acme-9876 — creating BILL-6789 for investigation.

jamie_ops: sara, can you share their minimal repro (curl or SDK call)?

sara_support: Pasting what they used (sanitized):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REPLACED' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-Project: acme-9876' \n  -d '{"model":"xllama-2-13b", "input":"hello"}'
```

sara_support: They retried client-side on 429 and sometimes got 401 after the routed request hit na-east.

mike_infra: Pasting allocator excerpt (sanitized):

```
[14:23:08] allocator: request=rid=abc123 tenant=acme-9876 region=eu-west1 -> NoCompatibleNode
[14:23:09] allocator: routing fallback to region=na-east
[14:23:09] auth: validate-token tenant=acme-9876 -> token-not-found
[14:23:09] proxy: upstream returned 401 for rid=abc123
[14:23:10] allocator: request retry count=1 -> queued-for-retry
[14:23:11] billing: record-charge rid=abc123 amount_usd=0.003 status=recorded
[14:23:12] billing: duplicate-event-check rid=abc123 found duplicate=true
```

ravi_sre: That "token-not-found" when routing to na-east smells like the fallback pool isn't wired to the same auth mapping (service account / SA token distribution). The auth cache may not replicate fast enough for sudden cross-region failover.

jamie_ops: Agreed. Two failure modes to solve: (1) allocator should prefer queueing + longer short-backoff before cross-region fallback when auth context not present; (2) ensure auth mappings are available in fallback pools or fail early with clear 503 to avoid client-side retries creating billing duplicates.

emma_cse: Customer asks for immediate mitigation and ETA. Can we short-term pin them to eu-west1 only (no-fallback) while we fix?

mike_infra: We can patch their routing to fallback=false per-tenant quickly. Doing a config flip for acme-9876 now.

deploy-bot: Config change for tenant acme-9876 (fallback=false) queued in org-config service, rollout in ~2m.

ravi_sre: For medium-term: we should (A) add auth mapping replication to allocator cold-start path, (B) change allocator policy to require auth-success in fallback before reroute, (C) add idempotency keys for billing to prevent duplicate charges from retries.

billing-bot: Created billing investigation ticket BILL-6789 and linked to incident INC-12345.

jamie_ops: Action items I captured: 1) Patch per-tenant fallback flag (mike) — DONE/rolling, 2) Fix auth replication path + add guard in allocator (ravi + mike), 3) Add billing idempotency and duplicate-detection improvements (billing team), 4) Customer comms update (emma + sara).

emma_cse: I'll send a hold message to AE and update the customer: "We temporarily pinned your queries to eu-west1 to avoid cross-region auth errors while we investigate. We're working on a durable fix and billing review."

sara_support: Customer update sent. They accepted the temporary workaround but want an RCA and billing credit if duplicates are confirmed.

mike_infra: Opening PR for allocator guard: https://git.redwood/infra/allocator/pulls/456 (adds auth-check before cross-region route + metrics). ETA for review + canary: 3h.

ravi_sre: I'll own auth replication fix and add a unit test for cross-region token lookup. Trying to get a hotfix into next allocator canary.

billing-bot: Billing investigation linked to incident. If duplicates confirmed we'll propose a credit and auto-adjust invoices for acme-9876.

deploy-bot: Allocator PR #456 CI green, canary scheduled on a small pool in eu-west1 in 12m.

sara_support: Thanks team. I'll keep AE and customer updated and postfinal RCA here once available. :thumbsup:
